Body-safe medical-grade silicone, IPX7 waterproof, travel-lock built in.

The bullet I keep recommending when friends say they want 'something small that actually works.' 10 patterns, tapered ceramic-coated tip for pinpoint stimulation, and a motor that punches above its weight. Genuinely quiet — you can use it in a hotel without that telltale buzz through the wall. Magnetic charging dock, ~90 min runtime, fully submersible. Comes in matte black or dusty rose.

Designed in Berlin, made in Taiwan.
